}}'''Dispatcher Tentacles''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] Tier.
==''Spawning''==
*Summoned at a target's location by all [[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatchers]] stages.
*Summoned by all [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]] except [[Grunt|Grunts]].
==''Behavior''==
Dispatcher Tentacles are utility parasites. They teleport parasites to their location and obey 2 different behaviors depending on what summoned them.

=== Dispatcher's Tentacles: ===

* When summoned by a Dispatcher, Dispatcher Tentacles will spawn a mob from the Dispatcher's inventory.
* Tentacles require specific conditions in order to spawn:
** There must be 3 full blocks below the position where it will teleport to.
** The sum of the 3 blocks' [[hardness]] values must be less than 10.

=== Personal Tentacles: ===

* Summoned by Pure Parasites in an area around them.
* No limits on hardness or block height.
* Teleports their summoner and only their summoner.
===''Weaknesses''===
* Dispatcher Tentacles, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* The tentacles cannot be spawned on partial blocks.
* If enough distance is put between the player and the tentacle it will retract before performing its function.

==''Trivia'' ==
* Dispatcher Tentacles are also known as '''DodT''' in the Mod Files.
* A Dispatcher will not spawn any tentacles if you are more than four blocks above the ground.
